arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 120 python3 -c "
import sys, time
import run_tests, gen, json, verify
bad=0
for seed in range(6):
    req = gen.valid_request(seed)
    text = json.dumps(req, separators=(',',':'))
    t0=time.time()
    p, dt = run_tests.run(text)
    print(seed, 'run', round(time.time()-t0,2), p.returncode, len(p.stdout))
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print(p.stderr.decode()[-1000:]); bad+=1; continue
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        verify.check(text, p.stdout.decode())
        print('   verify ok', round(time.time()-t0,2))
    except verify.Bad as e:
        print('   VERIFY FAIL', e)
        bad+=1
print('bad', bad)
" 2>&1 | tail -20
